figures.derivation: 100 minus the 69% of the local authority and independent sector adult social care workforce that Skills for Care states had a British nationality in 2024/25. The report prints no non-British share at all. The subtraction is stated and read by a person; nothing recomputes it.

components.quote: The proportion of workers with a British nationality in the local authority and independent sectors has decreased from 73% in 2023/24 to 69% in 2024/25.
